correctness.rationale: The actual supplied executable exhausts the 18-vertex face set twice, constructs 11343 matched pairs and topologically verifies acyclicity on 132988 incidences, leaving one 0-, one 5-, four 7-cells. A gradient-projected cocycle is nontrivial (pairs 1 with a closed 5-cycle), and its four supporting 5-faces have pairwise union of at most seven vertices; every cup-three term of any 7-face needs union eight, so its cochain square is zero. A complete explicit Medina-Mardones parity-term calculation corroborates this. With pi_6(S^5)=Z/2 and detection by Sq2, the four attaching classes vanish. Exact bounded computer checks, no extrapolation.
